topic: Pourquoi les courbatures arrivent deux jours après

through_line.name: la fibre musculaire fendue
through_line.progression: intacte en bloc un (le badge arrive alors que tout va bien, la fibre est encore lisse) -> fendue en bloc deux (l'effort ouvre de petites encoches silencieuses dans les brins) -> assiegee en bloc trois (les blobs mint arrivent, la zone gonfle et devient douloureuse, deux jours plus tard) -> reparee en bloc quatre (l'encoche se referme et le brin ressort plus epais)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final referme l'encoche pendant que le personnage descend enfin l'escalier : la douleur du hook n'etait pas la blessure elle-meme mais le chantier de reparation, ce qui explique le decalage de deux jours

blocks.vo_line: Hier soir tu as fait du sport sans ressentir la moindre gêne. Et pourtant demain matin, descendre un escalier va devenir une vraie épreuve.
blocks.through_line_state: intacte : tout va bien, le badge apparait au dernier plan avec sa fibre encore lisse
shots: WIDE static: the person finishes a set of squats on the lavender mat and stands up, hands on hips, breathing out
MEDIUM static: they pick up the pink towel, wipe their forehead and give a satisfied thumbs up to the camera
CLOSE-UP low angle static: they bend one knee and pat their own thigh twice, shrugging as if to say nothing hurts
MEDIUM high angle static: they drink from the sandy water bottle, relaxed, the mint dumbbells resting on the mat beside them
MEDIUM static: the fibre badge swings in from the right and settles beside the person with a bounce, two sparkles popping

blocks.vo_line: Un effort intense crée des milliers de micro-déchirures dans tes fibres musculaires. Elles sont minuscules, indolores, et ton corps ne réagit pas tout de suite.
blocks.through_line_state: fendue : de petites encoches s'ouvrent dans les brins roses sous la tension, sans le moindre signal
shots: WIDE static: the bundle of five pink strands at rest, all smooth and intact, swaying very slightly together
MEDIUM lateral gentle drift right: the strands stretch and pull taut under tension, thinning slightly along their length
CLOSE-UP high angle static: a tiny rounded notch opens in the middle of one strand, then a second and a third appear on neighbouring strands
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: one single notch seen up close, its rounded edges perfectly still, no glow and no color change around it
MEDIUM low angle static: the strands relax back to rest, the little notches still there and completely quiet

blocks.vo_line: Le fameux acide lactique disparaît en moins de deux heures. La vraie douleur vient de la réparation des fibres, un chantier qui met deux jours à monter.
blocks.through_line_state: assiegee : les blobs mint arrivent en nombre, la zone gonfle et pulse — c'est ce chantier, pas la dechirure, qui fait mal
shots: WIDE static: the notched strands lie quiet; a single small mint green round blob drifts in from the left and stops beside one notch
MEDIUM static: a dozen more mint blobs arrive and gather around the notches, and the area swells gently into a soft rounded mound
CLOSE-UP high angle static: the mint blobs press in around one notch and the swollen mound pulses slowly, twice, pushing outward against the lavender sheath
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: two mint blobs stitching the notch closed with a soft mint thread, one small baby blue sparkle popping at each stitch
MEDIUM low angle static: pulled back on the whole bundle, every notch now closed and the strands slightly thicker than before

blocks.vo_line: Ces fibres repoussent ensuite un peu plus solides. Ta courbature est le reçu de ta séance : abonne-toi, demain on regarde les gargouillis du ventre.
blocks.through_line_state: reparee : l'encoche se referme et le brin ressort plus epais, pendant que le personnage finit enfin son escalier
shots: WIDE static: the person starts down the sandy steps, grabs the mint handrail with both hands and winces, moving very slowly
EXTREME CLOSE-UP static on the badge: the small notch in the pink strand closes up smoothly and the strand thickens slightly, one baby blue sparkle popping above it
MEDIUM low angle static: the person reaches the bottom step, straightens up and rubs the front of one thigh, then nods slowly
CLOSE-UP static: they look down at their own leg and break into a proud grin, chin lifting
CLOSE-UP low angle static: the person points at the viewer, a rounded sandy yellow bell shape pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
